title: Bitter Kale Delight
description: A refreshing salad combining the earthy flavors of kale with the tangy taste of bitter greens.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, massage the kale with your hands for about 2 minutes to soften it.
2. Add the bitter greens to the bowl and toss to combine.
3. In a small bowl, whisk together the apple cider vinegar and olive oil.
4. Pour the dressing over the kale and bitter greens, and toss to coat.
6. Serve immediately, garnished with additional bitter greens if desired.
